summary:
Many people return from a break and feel flat again within days. Rest helps, but burnout is also about the conditions that keep draining you.

In this article, psychologist Matthew Hallam explains why, in studies of healthy workers, the lift from a holiday tends to fade after the return to work, and why recovery from burnout often involves changes to work as well as rest.

Equal Psychology provides psychological support for adults experiencing burnout and chronic stress in Kew, Croydon, and online across Melbourne.

Medicare rebates available with a GP referral.

Read more: https://equalpsychology.com.au/blog/burnout-recovery-why-rest-is-not-the-whole-answer
